children: DA Davidson maintained their Buy rating on First Watch Restaurant Gr's stock with a price target of $15.00.
The price target implies an upside of 46.6% from the Oct 1 close of $10.23.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: First Watch's strategic shift in marketing expenditures towards higher-ROI digital channels has effectively enhanced brand awareness and customer acquisition. This approach, coupled with the successful launch of new menu items, has led to improved traffic and sales performance, reinforcing confidence in the company's growth potential.

: Despite external economic pressures, management has indicated stable demand trends, allowing for an optimistic forecast for same-store sales growth. This resilience, combined with expected positive traffic inflection and improved operational efficiencies from moderated unit growth, positions First Watch favorably for sustained financial performance.
